current_state: 08-03 Docker dashboard packaging is complete. Commit 2ca0fb0 builds web/dist in a Node Docker stage, copies it into the runtime image, and CI run 26600306093 proved the container serves /v1/health/simple, /dashboard, and one bundled /dashboard/assets hash asset. Next slice is 08-04 release/tag automation guardrail.

decisions.decision: Open Phase 08 rather than tagging immediately.
decisions.rationale: User asked to keep building OpenHub. Codebase concerns still list CI absence and dashboard packaging verification as critical release gaps.

decisions.decision: CI must use dummy credentials and local temp DB state only.
decisions.rationale: OpenHub is security-first; no local admin/API/provider secrets belong in repository or CI logs.

decisions.decision: Docker bundles dashboard assets rather than relying on checkout-local web/dist.
decisions.rationale: FastAPI only mounts /dashboard when web/dist/index.html exists beside the app; release packaging now proves the image contains and serves those assets.

decisions.decision: Release/tag automation stays manual and non-publishing unless explicitly selected.
decisions.rationale: 08-04 must prepare safe guardrails without implicitly creating tags or using PyPI/Docker registry secrets.
